messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with his back to the camera, then walks slowly forward across the wet ground.","camera":"Static, eye-level medium-full shot from behind the character.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top, light blue shorts with white trim, and red sandals.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a dark-skinned, athletic build, seen from behind.","scene":"A futuristic city plaza with a wet, reflective concrete floor, glowing red and cyan light strips, and tall buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the character from behind in a full-body framing, matching the reference's viewing direction and placement. The character is seen walking slowly away across the wet futuristic plaza, and the camera remains largely static.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a full-body shot from behind, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, scene, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the character's identity and upper-body appearance were fully preserved, since the face and front of the tank top are not visible in the output.
unexpected_changes: The character's action changed from standing and turning in the source to walking away from the camera in the output.
The scene changed from the source's glass-fronted building with a large circular neon display to a different futuristic plaza with buildings, light strips, and a different background layout.
The character's lower-body clothing is now visible as light blue shorts and red sandals, whereas the source only showed the upper body and jeans were partially visible.
The character's facial expression is no longer visible because the camera is behind him.
